camel_example: aliyun ehpc ListPreferredEcsTypes --region cn-hangzhou --ZoneId 'cn-hangzhou-b' --InstanceChargeType PostPaid --SpotStrategy NoSpot
description_en: Queries the Elastic Compute Service (ECS) instance types recommended by Elastic High Performance Computing (E-HPC)
description_zh: 查询 E-HPC 推荐的 ECS 实例规格
kebab_example: aliyun ehpc list-preferred-ecs-types --zone-id cn-hangzhou-b --spot-strategy NoSpot --instance-charge-type PostPaid --api-version 2018-04-12 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListPreferredEcsTypes

parameters.help_en:
The bidding policy of the ECS instance. Valid values:

*   NoSpot: The instance is created as a pay-as-you-go instance.
*   SpotWithPriceLimit: The instance is created as a preemptible instance with a user-defined maximum hourly price.
*   SpotAsPriceGo: The instance is created as a preemptible instance for which the market price at the time of purchase is automatically used as the bidding price
parameters.help_zh:
ECS实例竞价策略。取值范围：
- NoSpot：正常按量付费实例。
- SpotWithPriceLimit：设置上限价格的抢占式实例。
- SpotAsPriceGo：系统自动出价，跟随当前市场实际价格
parameters.name: spot_strategy

parameters.help_en:
The billing method of the ECS instances. Valid values:

*   PostPaid
*   PrePaid
parameters.help_zh:
ECS实例的付费类型。取值范围：
- PostPaid：按量付费。
- PrePaid：包年包月
parameters.name: instance_charge_type
